inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: In the cafeteria area the ceiling is leaking water and there is trash can placed in the middle of the floor to catch the water.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs: Caregivers had the incorrect amount of children checked in, in the infant room, and on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Tracking System or Sign-in and Sign-out Logs (26 TAC §746.603(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on information obtained during the investigation the operation failed to complete the incident report thoroughly and to include all relevant information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation there was a sufficient amount of evidence to determine that the playground was not inspected to ensure hazards were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on information provided during the DFPS investigation inspection there is enough evidence to prove that a child was located outside of the operation near a roadway and another child was observed on the playground without adult supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information provided during the DFPS investigation there is enough information to determine that the caregiver did not bring the children to the age-appropriate play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation there is enough information to determine that the gate was unlocked on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation there is a sufficient amount of information and evidence to support the allegation of neglectful supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In the infant 2 classroom there were 7 infants ages 12-17 months with one caregiver present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A 3 year old child was observed walking into the office alone from lunch.     The assitant director came from the back and brought the child to their classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: The 3 year old teacher was heard yelling at the children to sit down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: In the infant room a 4 month old was asleep in there rocker.     This was corrected during the inspection when the child was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on information provided during the investigation there is enough information to conclude that the required incident report was not completed by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: Based on information provided there is a sufficient amount of information to conclude that the operation did not report this incident to licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: During inspection it was obersved the child safety alarm requires activation by person and is not automated based on ignition.    Note:Director Adetola added back the alarm inside the transportation. Director Adetola retested the alarm as the alarm is working properly. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: During inspection it was observed outside playground, the fences did not have locks , to which it is accessible to children's safety.     Note: Director: Adetola put locks on the fence playground. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The director's attendance record was not available  to review during the inspection time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: One caregiver did not the educational requirements on file during the monitoring inspection. Reasonable extensions have been provided to obtain the document.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Transportation training was last taken by the caregiver that provides transportation on 04/16/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children's records did not have the health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by  caregivers.  The  required training topics are 1. emergency preparedness 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 3. administering medication 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction  and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by director.  The  required training topics are 1. emergency preparedness 2. communicable diseases to include immunizations 3. administering medication 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: The keys to the locks to 2 fence gates did not work.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: One caregiver did not the educational requirements on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: One child's record did not have the school information filled out.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: One fence gate for the outdoor play area was unhinged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three children's records lacked the updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During the walkthrough I observed a drainage hole with no cover on the ground, wooden boards/barriers that were on the ground and exposed rod iron. I also observed broken toys placed in the corner of the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: During the walkthrough I obseved play equipment with 4 screws exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the walkthrough a caregiver was found to be caring for 8 children between the ages 13-17 months. Ratio was 1: 5 for a SAG of 12-17 months. The caregiver was over by 3 children.     This was corrected when the director placed another teacher in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: It was found that the operation failed to provide the child's parents with an incident/illness report form within 48 hours of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: The operation failed to report an injury that required medical treatment by a healthcare professional with in 48 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
